# Pratik Purohit

>  Technical Manager, Solution Architect and Engineering Leader with 9+ years across enterprise application development, solution architecture, cloud, DevOps, security governance, delivery leadership and AI-assisted engineering. Has led cross-functional teams of up to 18.

Canonical site: https://pratikpurohit.com
Primary positioning: Technical Manager | Solution Architect | Engineering Leader
Short index: https://pratikpurohit.com/llms.txt

## Professional summary
Pratik designs, modernises and leads delivery for scalable enterprise applications across telecom, BFSI and fintech, pharmaceutical, SaaS, gaming and enterprise-platform environments. His experience covers multi-tier and microservices-based systems, REST and SOAP integrations, database engineering, AWS and Azure platforms, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, application security and performance optimisation.

He leads end-to-end technical delivery from HLD and LLD, architecture governance and technology decisions through project planning, RAID/RAG tracking, release and change management, go-live, hypercare and production readiness. He applies AI as an engineering multiplier using Claude Code, Gemini, Hermes and LLM APIs, with prompt guardrails, PII handling, output validation and human accountability.

Source: https://pratikpurohit.com/about/

## Independent product
SPAR (Smart PDF Audio Reader) is Pratik's Android application for turning text-based PDF documents into natural text-to-speech audio. It includes smart chapter detection, background playback, Android Auto support and saved listening progress. Built with Flutter and published on Google Play. Official page: https://pratikpurohit.com/spar/
